log: PelicanCannonSupport 0.1.0 BUILD: select Pelican Cannon Support in the custom panel, then a mission; call it with LEFT DOWN LEFT UP LEFT UP.

stratagems.name: PELICAN CANNON SUPPORT
stratagems.description: Calls down a Pelican for close air support. Hovers around the beacon for 90 seconds and bombards nearby enemies with a heavy burst autocannon.
